data.body: Consolidating into epic 9b71-55b3-1bd1-4a97 (completion gate loop breaker) — this scenario is covered, with one important design correction. Your detection proposal (consecutive-repeat threshold, default 5) is the exact metric ticket 70bc-ab05-6d4c-45a0 proved INVERTED on real traces: a k-cycle with k>=2 never repeats adjacently (bf31's 4-call cycle repeated 31-37x scores max_consecutive_repeat=1), and the HEALTHY 258-call run scores 5 — your default threshold sits exactly on the healthy run's value. The adopted detector is a windowed distinct-ratio (distinct_ratio_window, window 24, trip <=0.50, order-insensitive): your 131x adjacent case craters it to ~0.04 (fires within ~24 calls), and it also catches the cycles adjacency misses, never firing on the healthy profile (min w24 ratio 0.833). Your actuator (stop + distinct message) is subsumed by c827's adopted route: typed RunawayToolLoopError -> classified ahead of the provider-outage sweep -> bounded per-criterion recovery + tool-free finalizer, so the run ends with a VERDICT where possible, and a gate_error_v1 sidecar naming the loop (not 'raise REBAR_LLM_MAX_STEPS') where not. Your requests=240 tool_calls=260 distinct=120 max_consecutive_repeat=131 trace is a valuable third pathological test vector (adjacent-repeat mode) and is being pinned in the detector tests alongside the 4-cycle and the healthy control. 94a3-1323-3497-4f59 (in_progress, merged, 17 ACs, blocked only by this gate defect) is noted as the ready-made live verification case for the epic. Also for the record: 4 of 5 measured pathological runs LOOPED on search_files AFTER the 85805e02f1 fix landed, so the loop mode does not depend on the pre-fix lying tool.
